newsitem.title: ITALY: ALPINE SKIING-SYKORA WINS AGAIN, TOMBA SECOND.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-SYKORA WINS AGAIN, TOMBA SECOND.

text.p: Austria's Thomas Sykora clinched his second men's Alpine skiing slalom win of the season on Tuesday in an unofficial one minute 37.90 seconds, ahead of a remarkable run by Italian Alberto Tomba.

Tomba, making his season's debut in front of a raucous home crowd after being sidelined by injury, was second in 1:38.48 after clocking the fastest second-leg time on the 62-gate Canalone Miramonti piste.
France's Sebastien Amiez, lucky to escape serious injury in a heavy fall in the morning warm-up, took third place in a time of 1:38.52 after being second-fastest in the first leg.
Sykora forged further ahead in the world slalom standings with 280 points, after winning the opening race of the season at Park City last month and finishing second in Breckenridge.
